finding.proposition: After a committed retained-grant claim, the ledger view leaves the effect-applied proposition unresolved. A bound applied settlement supports it, and a bound definite no-effect settlement refutes it. Missing, swapped, wrong-call, write-contradicted, and unrelated terminal records leave it unresolved. The refutation is only of that proposition. Both arms satisfy this contract.
